Cropland area, including fallow areas and temporary meadows and pastures. Estimation based on conversion factors from harvested area to crop area, scaled to FAO total crop area by crop group (permanent vs. temporary crops). Due to likely reporting inconsistencies between FAO harvested and total cropland area, the harvested area to crop area conversion ratio was capped between 0.5 and 2 to avoid unlikely cropland estimates. In cases where FAO reports crop area but CCROPgrids does not, a ratio of 1 between harvested area and crop area is a assumed.
